# PICO-PI firmware config. See https://www.raspberrypi.com/documentation/computers/config_txt.html

# A/B system slots: slot.txt holds "os_prefix=a/" or "os_prefix=b/", which
# selects the kernel, cmdline.txt, DTBs and overlays of that slot. OTA updates
# write the inactive slot and then flip this one line.
include slot.txt
kernel=Image

# Fast, quiet boot
disable_splash=1
boot_delay=0
disable_overscan=1

# KMS display driver (required for SDL2 kmsdrm) + audio
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
max_framebuffers=2
dtparam=audio=on
